title: TUI: two-pane browser — foldable epic/pebble tree, detail pane
description: Left pane: foldable tree of epics with child pebbles (reuses list --tree data and epic progress counts). Right pane: detail of the highlighted issue — show output, relationships, incoming links, spec refs. Keys: j/k or arrows to move, Enter/f to fold/unfold, ? for help. Widget choice pending tui-tree-widget evaluation.
